versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the animejs skill.
- Provides Anime.js adapter patterns for use within HyperFrames compositions.
- Details contract and best practices for deterministic, seek-based animation control via HyperFrames.
- Includes HTML/JS examples for both basic and timeline animation registrations.
- Highlights compatibility with both script and ES module builds of Anime.js.
- Lists recommended usage and common pitfalls to avoid.
